name: Ngrok
description: Official Ngrok tunnel agent (ngrok/ngrok:3.39.13-alpine) with web inspection dashboard on port 4040 and an optional Nginx filter sidecar (ngrok-filtros) configured via inline Base64 without host file mounts to serve 404 on / while forwarding routes to Runtipi's Traefik reverse proxy.
short_desc: Ngrok tunnel agent with optional Nginx root-404 Traefik filter
author: ngrok

form_fields.label: NGROK_AUTHTOKEN
form_fields.hint: Ngrok authentication token from your Ngrok dashboard.

form_fields.label: NGROK_URL
form_fields.hint: Optional static domain or tunnel URL (--url), such as my-url.ngrok-free.dev. Leave blank to let Ngrok assign an ephemeral URL.

form_fields.label: ENABLE_NGINX_FILTER
form_fields.hint: Enable the optional ngrok-filtros Nginx sidecar (tunnels to ngrok-filtros:80, returns 404 on /, and proxies other paths to runtipi-reverse-proxy:80). Disable to tunnel directly to NGROK_TARGET. Default: true.

form_fields.label: NGROK_TARGET
form_fields.hint: Target port or host:port (for example 80, 8080, or container:8080) used when ngrok-filtros is disabled. Leave blank to default to 80.

form_fields.label: NGINX_CONF_BASE64
form_fields.hint: Optional Base64 or data:application/octet-stream;base64,... Nginx server block used when ngrok-filtros is enabled. Leave blank to use the built-in 404 root filter and Traefik proxy.

form_fields.label: container_name
form_fields.hint: Custom Docker container name for the Ngrok agent. Default: ngrok (if left blank, falls back to ngrok).
form_fields.pattern_error: Must start with a letter or number and contain at least 2 characters (letters, numbers, '.', '_' or '-').

form_fields.label: filters_container_name
form_fields.hint: Custom Docker container name for the optional Nginx filter sidecar. Default: ngrok-filtros (if left blank, falls back to ngrok-filtros).
form_fields.pattern_error: Must start with a letter or number and contain at least 2 characters (letters, numbers, '.', '_' or '-').
